tasks.instruction: Install the versioned candidate archive in a fresh project; report the version shown by glocon --version.
Run UI setup and glocon check in a representative application; inspect phone and desktop reports.
Use a test session for one protected page, then invalidate it and check the result.
Configure actual loading, error, retry, empty and success states using the application API behavior.
Review each reported finding against the actual application and record its disposition.
With a qualified business reviewer, supply real reviewed catalog/rate inputs and independent expected amounts for successful quote and invoice cases plus expected refusals.
Compare retained receipts and business rounding policy before and after the shared India default change, if applicable.
Report whether the toolkit reduced work, which results led to fixes, and which required workflows it does not support.

limits: A prepared trial sheet does not establish independent user validation; leave outcome fields empty until the actual trial occurs.
